Following three negative gameplay comparisons, the Cemu candidate adds a narrow 0.5-to-1.0 physical-travel adaptation at both final integrations of ordinary-swim state 9; the pack is disabled by default pending post-fix gameplay verification. Mapping confidence: global-semantic-with-exact-scalars.
